package postgres

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

// CourseOutlineRepoPG loads a lightweight public course hierarchy without
// lesson bodies, task payloads, or per-node queries.
type CourseOutlineRepoPG struct {
	Pool *pgxpool.Pool
}

func (r CourseOutlineRepoPG) GetPublic(ctx context.Context, courseID string, lang string) (*domain.CourseOutline, error) {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)

	var outline domain.CourseOutline
	err := runner.QueryRow(ctx, `
WITH requested_i18n AS (
    SELECT id FROM i18n WHERE language = $1
)
SELECT
    c.id,
    c.slug,
    COALESCE(ci.title, ci_fallback.title, c.slug)
FROM course c
LEFT JOIN requested_i18n ri ON TRUE
LEFT JOIN course_i18n ci ON ci.course_id = c.id AND ci.i18n_id = ri.id
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT title
    FROM course_i18n
    WHERE course_id = c.id
    ORDER BY i18n_id
    LIMIT 1
) ci_fallback ON TRUE
WHERE c.id = $2
  AND c.status = $3
  AND c.catalog_visible = TRUE`, lang, courseID, domain.CourseStatusActive).Scan(
		&outline.CourseID,
		&outline.Slug,
		&outline.Title,
	)
	if err != nil {
		if err == pgx.ErrNoRows {
			return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
		}
		return nil, err
	}

	rows, err := runner.Query(ctx, `
WITH requested_i18n AS (
    SELECT id FROM i18n WHERE language = $1
)
SELECT
    m.id,
    COALESCE(mi.title, mi_fallback.title, ''),
    cm."order",
    s.id,
    COALESCE(si.title, si_fallback.title, ''),
    ms."order",
    l.id,
    COALESCE(li.title, li_fallback.title, l.title),
    sl."order",
    COALESCE(task_counts.tasks_count, 0)
FROM course c
JOIN course_module cm ON cm.course_id = c.id AND cm.status = $3
JOIN module m ON m.id = cm.module_id AND m.status = $3
JOIN module_section ms ON ms.module_id = m.id AND ms.status = $3
JOIN section s ON s.id = ms.section_id AND s.status = $3
JOIN section_lesson sl ON sl.section_id = s.id AND sl.status = $3
JOIN lesson l ON l.id = sl.lesson_id AND l.status = $3
LEFT JOIN requested_i18n ri ON TRUE
LEFT JOIN module_i18n mi ON mi.module_id = m.id AND mi.i18n_id = ri.id
LEFT JOIN section_i18n si ON si.section_id = s.id AND si.i18n_id = ri.id
LEFT JOIN lesson_i18n li ON li.lesson_id = l.id AND li.i18n_id = ri.id
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT title
    FROM module_i18n
    WHERE module_id = m.id
    ORDER BY i18n_id
    LIMIT 1
) mi_fallback ON TRUE
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT title
    FROM section_i18n
    WHERE section_id = s.id
    ORDER BY i18n_id
    LIMIT 1
) si_fallback ON TRUE
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT title
    FROM lesson_i18n
    WHERE lesson_id = l.id
    ORDER BY i18n_id
    LIMIT 1
) li_fallback ON TRUE
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS tasks_count
    FROM task t
    WHERE t.lesson_id = l.id AND t.status = $3
) task_counts ON TRUE
WHERE c.id = $2
  AND c.status = $4
  AND c.catalog_visible = TRUE
ORDER BY
    cm."order" ASC,
    m.id ASC,
    ms."order" ASC,
    s.id ASC,
    sl."order" ASC,
    l.id ASC`, lang, courseID, domain.ModuleStatusActive, domain.CourseStatusActive)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer rows.Close()

	outline.Modules = make([]domain.CourseOutlineModule, 0)
	moduleIndexes := make(map[string]int)
	sectionIndexes := make(map[string]map[string]int)

	for rows.Next() {
		var moduleID, moduleTitle string
		var moduleOrder int
		var sectionID, sectionTitle string
		var sectionOrder int
		var lesson domain.CourseOutlineLesson
		if err := rows.Scan(
			&moduleID,
			&moduleTitle,
			&moduleOrder,
			&sectionID,
			&sectionTitle,
			&sectionOrder,
			&lesson.ID,
			&lesson.Title,
			&lesson.Order,
			&lesson.TasksCount,
		); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}

		moduleIndex, ok := moduleIndexes[moduleID]
		if !ok {
			moduleIndex = len(outline.Modules)
			moduleIndexes[moduleID] = moduleIndex
			sectionIndexes[moduleID] = make(map[string]int)
			outline.Modules = append(outline.Modules, domain.CourseOutlineModule{
				ID:       moduleID,
				Title:    moduleTitle,
				Order:    moduleOrder,
				Sections: make([]domain.CourseOutlineSection, 0),
			})
		}

		sectionIndex, ok := sectionIndexes[moduleID][sectionID]
		if !ok {
			sectionIndex = len(outline.Modules[moduleIndex].Sections)
			sectionIndexes[moduleID][sectionID] = sectionIndex
			outline.Modules[moduleIndex].Sections = append(
				outline.Modules[moduleIndex].Sections,
				domain.CourseOutlineSection{
					ID:      sectionID,
					Title:   sectionTitle,
					Order:   sectionOrder,
					Lessons: make([]domain.CourseOutlineLesson, 0),
				},
			)
		}

		outline.Modules[moduleIndex].Sections[sectionIndex].Lessons = append(
			outline.Modules[moduleIndex].Sections[sectionIndex].Lessons,
			lesson,
		)
	}
	if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &outline, nil
}

var _ repository.CourseOutlineRepository = (*CourseOutlineRepoPG)(nil)
